name: lms
description: Brightverse Academy LMS: admin, teacher and student dashboards

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/web run build && npm --prefix apps/api run build
scripts.start: cd apps/api && npm run db:migrate:prod && WEB_DIST=../web/dist/web/browser node dist/main.js
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/web test -- --watch=false
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && npm --prefix apps/web run e2e
